title: The Three Pure Precepts
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett and Myoki Raizelah Bayen
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes embracing all aspects of ourselves, including our flaws and weaknesses, as a means of realizing awakened reality and cultivating compassion for ourselves and others. By welcoming and accepting our true nature, we can break free from self-clinging and rigid rules, and instead embody kindness, awareness, and harmony with the world around us. This practice is not about suppressing or overcoming our imperfections, but rather about embracing them as an opportunity to grow and deepen our connection with ourselves and others.
